identity.name: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Ltd
identity.industry: Precision components / **electrification & current-sensing** (adjacent to Power/Grid, not a transformer-component)

summary.oneLiner: A precision-engineering platform moving **strip → components → assemblies** (PCBA, busbars) for **current sensing, smart metering, EV/BMS and electrification**. FY26: rev +12% but **EBITDA +26% / margin 22.9% (+250bps)** — a deliberate value-add / mix-up story (shunt component mix 55→65% = +10–12% realization). NOT a transformer-component play; sits in the **adjacent electrification / smart-metering** layer of the broader power theme.

one-line thesis: A precision-engineering platform moving strip → components → assemblies (PCBA, busbars) for current sensing, smart metering, EV/BMS and electrification. FY26: rev +12% but EBITDA +26% / margin 22.9% (+250bps) — a deliberate value-add / mix-up story (shunt component mix 55→65% = +10–12% realization). NOT a transformer-component play; sits in the adjacent electrification / smart-metering layer of the broader power theme.
financial scorecard: > Standalone revenue grew on stable volumes → all realization/mix (less low-value strip, more engineered components). Electric contacts +~60% rev, but ~half is silver-price pass-through (real business growth ~31–32%); silver has minimal margin impact (small surcharge).
guidance / outlook: No hard numbers; FY27 priorities: margin quality, working-capital efficiency, value-add components, deeper OEM/Tier-1 partnerships.
Contacts: expects growth "possibly more than" FY26 (deferred business now serviceable after new plant).
Shunt realization keeps rising as component mix climbs.
segments / drivers: Shunts: India strong — automotive, smart metering, current sensing, BMS, energy management.
Thermostatic bimetals: Europe strong (local presence + export momentum).
Electric contacts: big growth (general business + silver); new plant added capacity (was capacity-stressed); customers prefer Shivalik → set up quickly; relay/smart-meter demand.
Pune facility: PCBA + busbar assemblies for automotive/electrification — integrated, application-ready solutions.
Geography: India largest; Europe = growth engine; Asia broad momentum; Americas soft (normalizing).
margins / mix: Margin expansion from value-add mix (components/assemblies vs strip), operating leverage, cost discipline.
risks & watch-items: Silver/commodity price swings (revenue optics in contacts, limited margin effect).
Americas softness; EV adoption "turbulence in between."
Execution of the move to integrated assemblies (PCBA/busbar) — newer capability.
non-obvious takeaways: This is an electrification + smart-metering + EV current-sensing beneficiary, not a transformer-shortage name — different layer of the power value chain (slot it as an adjacency in the sector view).
The real story is mix-led margin expansion (EBITDA +26% on rev +12%), not volume.
qoq change log: Q4/FY26 (this): rev ₹570.9cr (+12%), EBITDA 22.9% (+250bps), PAT ₹95.8cr; shunt component mix 55→65%; contacts +60% (~half silver); Pune PCBA/busbar capability; Europe strong, Americas soft.
Q1 FY27 → check: contacts growth ex-silver, shunt realization, Pune assemblies ramp, Americas normalization.
